cards.front: Recall a key point about Articles, Adjectives and Agreement
cards.back: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for articles, adjectives and agreement. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse spanish exam tips?
cards.back: All Spanish nouns have gender (masculine/feminine) and number (singular/plural). Adjectives must agree in gender and number. Most adjectives follow the noun. Demonstratives (este, ese, aquel) show distance. Possessive adjectives (mi, tu, su) agree with the noun owned.
the subjunctive (e.g. El subjuntivo expresa duda y emoción)

cards.front: What does la cláusula subordinada mean?
cards.back: the subordinate clause (e.g. El subjuntivo va en la cláusula subordinada)

cards.front: What does el cambio de sujeto mean?
cards.back: the subject change (e.g. Si no hay cambio de sujeto, usa el infinitivo)
the will/wish (e.g. Después de verbos de voluntad, usa el subjuntivo)
the emotion (e.g. El subjuntivo expresa emoción)
the doubt (e.g. No creo que venga = duda)
hopefully (e.g. Ojalá que apruebe el examen)

cards.front: What does es necesario que mean?
cards.back: it is necessary that (e.g. Es necesario que estudiemos más)

cards.front: What does me gusta que mean?
cards.back: I like that (e.g. Me gusta que haga sol)

cards.front: What does no creo que mean?
cards.back: I don't believe that (e.g. No creo que sea verdad)
so that (e.g. Estudio para que pueda aprobar)

cards.front: What does es posible que mean?
cards.back: it is possible that (e.g. Es posible que llueva mañana)
